description: This Java class defines a minimal client for interacting with Supabase services, including PostgREST for database operations and Storage API for file management. It provides methods for querying, inserting, deleting database rows, as well as uploading and deleting files from storage.

classes.name: SupabaseClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Supabase REST API and Storage, supporting operations like querying tables, inserting, deleting, uploading, and deleting storage objects.

methods.name: restUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for PostgREST endpoints based on the base URL and provided path.

methods.name: storageUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for Storage API endpoints based on the base URL and provided path.

methods.name: toSupabaseException
methods.description: Converts an error response from the Supabase API into a Mono of SupabaseException.

methods.name: getGalleryRows
methods.description: Fetches rows from a specified table and query, returning JSON data.

methods.name: insertRow
methods.description: Inserts a row into a specified table with given JSON data and returns the inserted row.

methods.name: deleteRows
methods.description: Deletes rows from a specified table based on a filter query.

methods.name: uploadToBucket
methods.description: Uploads a file to a specified storage bucket at a given path.

methods.name: deleteObject
methods.description: Deletes a storage object from a specified bucket and path.

methods.name: publicObjectUrl
methods.description: Constructs a public URL for a storage object.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonNode, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: encodePath
methods.description: Encodes a file path segment for safe inclusion in URLs.
